title: Compensation of administrator.
bodyText: Compensation to an administrator for adjusting or settling claims shall not be increased contingent on claim experience. This section shall not prevent the compensation of an administrator from being based on premiums or charges collected or number of claims paid or processed.
bodyHtml: [§431:9J-109]  Compensation of administrator.  Compensation to an administrator for adjusting or settling claims shall not be increased contingent on claim experience.  This section shall not prevent the compensation of an administrator from being based on premiums or charges collected or number of claims paid or processed. [L 2019, c 72, pt of §1]
